visualCharacteristics.summary: Pinned full-viewport panel; numbered list of titles, one expanded at a time by scroll, its photo as the full-bleed backdrop
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Principles/values lists where each item has a backdrop image

contentPattern.summary: 4 principles (Openness, Breakthrough thinking, Connection, Passion), each with description and full-bleed backdrop photo; one active at a time, advanced by scroll
contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = item title; cell 2 = backdrop picture followed by the description paragraph(s). The block adds the 01., 02. ... numbers

usage: Pinned full-viewport panel, one viewport of scroll per item; scroll position selects the active item (expanded, its photo as backdrop). Clicking a title activates it and scrolls to its slice. Reduced motion: no pinning, click-to-activate only.
reuseGuidance: Principles/values lists where each item has a backdrop image
